verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de publishes public API docs at docs.beglaubigt.de. They cover concrete REST endpoints: POST/GET incorporation, POST notarization, POST translation, POST/GET tax registration, and POST trade registration at api.beglaubigt.de/v1. The docs also include HMAC-signed webhooks and an llms.txt that a probe confirmed is live. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), evidence of how API keys are issued and authenticated, independent or hands-on corroboration of real API use, and clarity on plan gating (the Compliance API is Enterprise-only).
